<thought>The search for templates using functional group criteria returned no results, likely because the specific functional groups involved (e.g., phosphonate) are not listed in the allowed set. To obtain the required template, I will perform a broader search that only specifies the target molecule SMILES, without any functional‑group filters. This should return any templates applicable to the product, from which I can identify the one that generates the listed precursors and retrieve its mapped reaction and template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
